$comment: Verified news source manifest. status: ok = confirmed usable | ok_caution = usable with caveats (see notes) | url_corrected = original spreadsheet URL was a portal/legacy URL, corrected here | broken = feed is dead, replacement suggested in notes
verification_method: Web research (RSS directories, official feed pages, outlet announcements). Live HTTP checks were blocked by the sandbox network egress policy - re-verify with a live fetch once network access to these domains is available.

sources.name: Google News (wrapper)
sources.notes: Works, no key. Caveats: unofficial and format can change; article links redirect through news.google.com (resolve redirects to recover the original URL for cross-source matching); rate-limit politely and cache. Useful for outlets without feeds (Reuters, AP, CNN).

sources.notes: Free, no key; confirmed live. Sibling feeds: /politics/, /technology/, /economics/, /wealth/, /industries/ + news.rss. Headline + summary only.
